div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 对焦前景 d<=0 (CoC=0, L=0.04), 失焦背景 d>=+1px (CoC=8px, L=1.00)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 检视轮廓外侧第 5 站背景像素 (d = +1 px, CoC_center = 8.0 px)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 按 CoC_center=8px 抓取 [-7, +9]px 全部邻居, 混入 7px 清晰前景暗色

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 输出 L=0.5800 (-0.4200 暗环损失), 在主角周围裹上 7px 假模糊黑边!

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 对每个采样点 y 检验其自身弥散圆是否覆盖当前像素: CoC(y) >= |x - y|

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 清晰前景点 (y<=0) 自身 CoC(y) = 0 < |x - y| -> 权重严格置 0!

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 仅累加真正失焦的背景采样点 (y>0, CoC(y)=8px) 并重归一化权重

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 第 5 站精准输出 L_DoF = 1.0000 (全 17 站 0 渗漏, 0 误差)
